title: Two stages on a heating curve
hints: Convert the molar phase change to sample heat.
statement:
A $0.500$ mol sample absorbs 1.60 kJ to reach its boiling point. Its molar vaporization enthalpy is 20.0 kJ/mol. What total heat warms it and vaporizes it completely?

[_]{a}

explanations: The full molar enthalpy was used for a half-mole.
Both warming and vaporization absorb heat.
